exposure: All original cohorts are exposed. New results are retrospective development diagnostics; no fresh confirmation admitted.
cohort: Original development groups only; original reserved groups excluded from selection and all continuation scores.
target: Viscosity at the next temperature block, calibrated using previous block
original_metric_preserved: mean whole-group physical-unit error remains reported, including the new normalized acoustic track

input_units.eta_previous: cP at preceding completed block, same shear rate
input_units.eta_first: cP at first completed block, same nominal sweep point; actual rate declared

grouping: Whole TestID / width-file / strain / stream-dateblock / sourcePING-run. 83 forward folds; others leave original whole-group folds out. All associated observations stay together.
fitting: All coefficients/scales/imputation/tuning use applicable training partitions only. Nested fold validation for tuned alternatives and flexible baselines. Same allowable inputs for all comparators.
baselines: Persistence/constant, established mechanistic prediction, original selected equations refit, train-only Gaussian residual kernel (80centers; widths0.5/1/2,ridges0.01/1). Strong causal-history linear comparator when applicable.
selection: Primary development criterion plus per-group noninferiority and complexity; <=1percent indistinguishable favors simplicity. No admission as fresh validated extension. Additional cycles chosen from actual prior residual/control evidence.
uncertainty: Paired whole-group errors; disclose number of distinct systems and serial/repeated dependence; no observation-level CI.
limits: This changes information access relative to static viscosity prediction: previous completed ramp measurements are declared online calibration for all comparators.
